prompts.title: How you learned about and engaged with Tufts (Short Answer #1)
prompts.text: Please describe how you have learned about and engaged with Tufts during your college search process.
prompts.note: Listed under 'Short Answer Prompts for the Class of 2031' on the official Tufts Admissions page, confirmed with fetch-text on 2026-11-06. First-year applicants answer two required short answer prompts: #1 for everyone, #2 specific to the school or program they apply to. This is Tufts' version of the 'Why Tufts?' question for 2026-27; required of all applicants, 75-150 words.

prompts.title: Favorite school assignment (Arts and Sciences, Short Answer #2)
prompts.text: Tell us about one of your favorite school assignments in the past two years. What was the assignment and why did you enjoy it?
prompts.note: Listed under 'Short Answer Prompts for the Class of 2031' on the official Tufts Admissions page, confirmed with fetch-text on 2026-11-06. First-year applicants answer two required short answer prompts: #1 for everyone, #2 specific to the school or program they apply to. Required of applicants to the School of Arts and Sciences, 100-200 words.

prompts.title: Engineering or science project (School of Engineering, Short Answer #2)
prompts.text: Tell us about an engineering or science-related project that you have helped build, design, create, or iterate in the past two years. What was the project and what was your role?
prompts.note: Listed under 'Short Answer Prompts for the Class of 2031' on the official Tufts Admissions page, confirmed with fetch-text on 2026-11-06. First-year applicants answer two required short answer prompts: #1 for everyone, #2 specific to the school or program they apply to. Required of applicants to the School of Engineering, 100-200 words.

prompts.title: Portfolio piece (BFA, Short Answer #2)
prompts.text: Tell us more about a specific piece in your portfolio. What were the ideas you intended to explore, and how did those ideas inform the process of making the piece?
prompts.note: Listed under 'Short Answer Prompts for the Class of 2031' on the official Tufts Admissions page, confirmed with fetch-text on 2026-11-06. First-year applicants answer two required short answer prompts: #1 for everyone, #2 specific to the school or program they apply to. Required of applicants to the Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) program at SMFA at Tufts, 100-200 words.

prompts.title: Portfolio piece and academics (Combined Degree BFA + BA/BS, Short Answer #2)
prompts.text: Tell us more about a specific piece in your portfolio. How did an academic course, project, or interest inspire the ideas that you explored in this piece? Or, how did making this piece influence your academic interests?
prompts.note: Listed under 'Short Answer Prompts for the Class of 2031' on the official Tufts Admissions page, confirmed with fetch-text on 2026-11-06. First-year applicants answer two required short answer prompts: #1 for everyone, #2 specific to the school or program they apply to. Required of applicants to the 5-year Combined Degree (BFA + BA/BS) program between SMFA at Tufts and the School of Arts and Sciences, 100-200 words; it replaces the BFA prompt for those applicants.

unreachableHosts.reason: Tufts Institute of the Environment site. The name does not resolve in DNS from here (the proxy answers 502 on CONNECT), although search engines still index its pages, including the Tufts Energy Conference. The TIE programs visible elsewhere (the Sustainable Water Management master's and environmental research fellowships) are graduate-level, so environmental facts cite engineering.tufts.edu, as.tufts.edu, sites.tufts.edu, and sustainability.tufts.edu instead.
Does not resolve in DNS (no address). The Civil and Environmental Engineering department is published at engineering.tufts.edu/cee/.
